_about: The Paladin's cards (the Paladin document, 12-paladin.md). One source per card: book/cards/README.md. Pack R-classes (2026-11-04): the class rebuilt for 4 AP + 1 Reaction AP and Escalation as a level (book/rework-r.md sections 12 and 14).

cards.name: Divine Power
cards.flavor: Your god's strength flows through your weapon and your hands.
cards.text: When you deal Holy damage to a creature with the Profane [[Tags|Tag]], that creature is Enfeebled 1 (EoT).

cards.name: Kindled Wrath
cards._note: Pack R-classes (2026-11-04): the Paladin's Escalation hook (rework-r.md 12.8; Core Rules, Escalation).
cards.flavor: Their blood on the ground is the spark your god was waiting for.
cards.text: Once an encounter, when an ally within 5 squares of you becomes Bloodied or goes Down, your [[Escalation]] increases by 1.

foundry._note: Pack R-Foundry 1 (v0.0.243): the Escalation hook setting; the system raises the Escalation and says so in the chat.

cards.name: Smite
cards.flavor: Your weapon blazes with holy light.

versions.effects: The target sheds [[Bright|Bright light]] in a 1 Emanation and takes 1 Bane when they try to [[Hide]], for 1 round.

foundry.text: The target sheds [[Bright|Bright light]] in a 2 Emanation and takes 1 Bane when they try to [[Hide]], for 1 round.

versions.effects: As 2 AP, and you or one ally in the Bright light gain [[Guard]] 1d8 + [Mod] (2d6 + [Mod] at Stage 2, 2d8 + [Mod] at Stage 3). The other creatures in the light, you excepted, are Pushed 1, away from the target.

foundry.text: The target sheds [[Bright|Bright light]] in a 2 Emanation and takes 1 Bane when they try to [[Hide]], for 1 round. You or one ally in the Bright light gain [[Guard]] 1d8 + [Mod] (2d6 + [Mod] at Stage 2, 2d8 + [Mod] at Stage 3). The other creatures in the light, you excepted, are Pushed 1, away from the target.

foundry.automationNote: the damage, the light on the target (the Damage button), then who gains the Guard (the Stage's dice) and the Pushes one by one (3 AP); the Bane on Hide by hand (Hide isn't written).

cards._note: Pack R-classes, part 3 (Lucas, 2026-11-04): more damage, no +1 Defense; the 3 AP Version is an explosion: the other creatures in the light are Pushed 1 away from the target (the target is the Push's origin; a Push's value is a maximum, so the Paladin moves each one 0 or 1: no "can" on cards, Lucas 2026-11-04). Cards 1 (Lucas, 2026-11-05): the first card written his way: book links (Bright light, Hide), the 2 and 3 AP texts written in full for Foundry (foundry.text), the light as an effect the Damage button applies (fx), the Guard's who-picker with the Modifier as a number and the Push picker after the damage (foundry.after).

cards.name: Lay On Hands
cards.flavor: Your touch carries your god's mercy.

versions.effects: The target can use 1 Rally Point.
The target can use 1 Rally Point, healing 1d6 + your Power Modifier more.

foundry.text: The target can use 2 Rally Points, healing 1d6 + your Power Modifier more.

foundry.automationNote: the Rally Points with the extra healing (the chip opens the Rally window; the Pow is the Paladin's).

cards._note: Pack R-classes, part 3 (Lucas, 2026-11-04): the Holy Strike rider is gone; the 2 and 3 AP Versions heal new Health on top of the Rally Points, a step above the future Heal Action (2 AP, a roll) at every AP.

cards.name: Shield of Faith
cards._note: Cards 4 (Lucas, 2026-11-06): Targets the triggering creature, no Distance (the Interrupt says it); the reduction is a chip with the Stage dice; the Reaction's moment waits for the Reactions pass.
cards.flavor: A shimmer of light holds steady between them and harm.
cards.interrupt: A [Strike] Action would damage you or an ally within 5 squares.

versions.effects: The damage that Strike deals to the target is reduced by 2d6 + your Power Modifier (3d6 at Stage 2, 4d6 at Stage 3).

foundry.automationNote: offered by itself in the Reactions message when a Strike would damage you or an ally within 5 squares (the damage waits); Use sets the reduction on that creature, taken from the held damage when it lands.

cards.name: Rebuke
cards._note: Pack R-classes, part 3 (Lucas, 2026-11-04): the Nova Paladin's Hallmark Reaction; a Trigger, not an Interrupt (an Interrupt that could cancel an Encounter Special on a Tier 2 Save was too strong), the first Reaction with a Save, Forced Movement and Frightened. Turn, within 5 squares (Lucas's option B: at Reach and Round it measured 0.1 AP a turn, the enemy next to the Paladin strikes the Paladin; within 5 squares 0.33 in damage plus the Push and Frightened).
cards.flavor: Strike my friends, and feel why you should not have.
cards.trigger: An enemy within 5 squares makes a [Strike] Action against an ally.

tiers: [R] 1d8 Ho; Pushed 2, and Frightened of you for 1 round.
versions.ruler: on 1: push 2; on 1: debuff Frightened (EoT); on 2: push 1

foundry.automationNote: offered by itself in the Reactions message after an enemy within 5 squares (its Distance) makes a Strike against an ally; Use makes the Save Action against that enemy (the Save and the damage: the card; Frightened is the condition item since v0.0.314, its Bane only while the enemy sees the Paladin). Since v0.0.334 (Lucas) the Push (2 on a Tier 1, 1 on a Tier 2) and Frightened of the Paladin (a Tier 1, 1 round) come by themselves once the damage is applied and lands.

cards.name: Holy Wrath
cards._note: Pack R-classes: the Encounter ceilings (decision sheet item 16): dice besides [W] and [Mod] at most the AP on Tier 2 and AP + 1 on Tier 3.
cards.flavor: For one blow, your god stops holding back.

cards.name: Word of Radiance
cards.flavor: You speak a word, and light pours from your hands across everything that stands against you.

foundry.automationNote: the Burst, the damage per target, then the Pushes one by one from the Burst's center (1 on Tier 2, 2 on Tier 3) and Prone on the Criticals (after the damage).

cards._note: Pack R-classes, part 3 (Lucas, 2026-11-04): a Burst (on a corner within 10 squares), Pushed 1 / 2 from the Burst's center on Tiers 2 and 3, Prone on a Critical. Cards 2 (Lucas, 2026-11-05): the Pushes and Prone run after the damage (foundry.after); the notes line about the Burst's center dropped (it is in the rules).

cards.name: Bulwark of Faith
cards._note: Cards 4 (Lucas, 2026-11-06): Targets the triggering creature, no Distance; the Guard chip reads Guard RP (a Rally Point's heal, the recipient's); the Slid comes on a second button after the damage (@Pause). The 'would damage' Interrupt stays: the Reactions pass can ask before the damage roll.
cards.flavor: You step into the blow meant for them, and your god holds the line with you.
cards.interrupt: A [Strike] Action would damage an ally within 5 squares.

versions.effects: The target gains [[Guard]] equal to what one of their Rally Points heals, before the damage. After the damage, they are Slid 1.

foundry.automationNote: offered by itself in the Reactions message when a Strike would damage an ally within 5 squares (the damage waits); Use gives the Guard to that ally before the held damage lands, then a second button, after the damage, Slides them 1.

cards.name: Beacon
cards._note: Pack R-classes, part 3 (Lucas, 2026-11-04): Aura of Protection reworked as an interactive Encounter Pick: 1 AP, 3 rounds, and a free step toward an ally who is hit. Cards 2 (Lucas, 2026-11-05): the step is an inline Action, Beacon's Step (0R, Round, Interrupt), the first of its kind; the Aura links to the book once.
cards.flavor: You plant your feet, and light rims the shoulders of everyone near you.
cards.target: You and allies in the Area

versions.effects: For 3 rounds, you and allies in the [[Aura]] gain +1 Defense. While the Beacon is active, you gain the following Action:

foundry.automationNote: the Beacon effect (the aura for 3 rounds, +1 Defense inside, Beacon's Step on the sheet while it lasts); the Step is offered by itself when an ally in the Aura takes damage (the Reactions message).

inline.name: Beacon's Step
inline.flavor: A step into the light, before the blow lands.
inline.interrupt: An ally in the Aura takes damage.
inline.automationNote: offered by itself in the Reactions message when an ally within 2 squares (the Aura) takes damage (the damage waits); the Evade is the card's button.

cards.name: Consecrated Ground
cards.flavor: You drive your weapon into the earth, and the earth answers.

versions.effects: For 3 rounds, enemies in the area take 1 Bane on [Weapon], [Power] and [Signature] Actions, and allies in it heal 1d4 at the start of each of their turns.
versions.ruler: rounds 3 | area 2 | allies 2 | banes 1 strike power; heal-dice 1d4
rounds 5 | area 2.5 | allies 2.5 | banes 1 strike power; heal-dice 1d4

foundry.text: For 5 rounds, enemies in the area take 1 Bane on [Weapon], [Power] and [Signature] Actions, and allies in it heal 1d4 at the start of each of their turns.

foundry.automationNote: the area is a Zone: enemies inside carry the Bane while inside, allies inside roll the 1d4 at the start of their turns and get their Heal window; the area ends after its rounds. The Heal chip on the card is for a heal by hand.

cards.name: Miraculous Recovery
cards.flavor: You lay both hands on the wound and call in a debt owed to your god.

versions.effects: The target heals twice what 1 Rally Point would heal, and you end one non-permanent effect of your choice on them.
As 2 AP, but three times what 1 Rally Point would heal.

foundry.text: The target heals three times what 1 Rally Point would heal, and you end one non-permanent effect of your choice on them.

foundry.automationNote: the Apply button: the heal (twice or three times the target's Rally Point heal, the target chooses the split) and the effect the target ends.

cards._note: Cards 3 (Lucas, 2026-11-05): the heal is a @Heal chip (rp*2 / rp*3: the target's own Rally Point heal, no Rally Point spent), the effect ended in a window; the target's player is prompted (the book says the Paladin chooses).

cards.name: Divine Intervention
cards.flavor: You reach out, and your god answers before you finish the prayer.
cards.interrupt: You or an ally within 5 squares would go Down.

versions.effects: Instead of going Down, the creature's total damage becomes 1 less than their Health Pool, and they gain [[Guard]] equal to what one of their Rally Points heals.

foundry.text: Instead of going Down, the creature's total damage becomes 1 less than their Health Pool, and they gain [[Guard]] equal to a Rally Point's healing.

foundry.automationNote: offered by itself in the Reactions message when you or an ally within 5 squares would go Down (Use / Pass for its owner; the damage waits for the answer); used, the damage stops 1 under the Health Pool and the Guard is applied. Nothing by hand.

cards._note: Pack R-classes, part 3 (Lucas, 2026-11-04): the saved creature also gains a Rally Point's worth of Guard. Cards session 5 (2026-11-06, Lucas): no Distance (the Interrupt says it), Targets the triggering creature, no button: the Reaction watches for the moment.

cards.name: Radiant Zeal
cards.flavor: The longer the fight, the brighter you burn.
cards.text: While your Escalation is 1 or more, the first [Strike] Action you make each round that deals damage deals an extra [R] 1d6 Ho.

cards.name: Divine Surge
cards._note: Pack R-classes: an Escalation 1 Passive (decision sheet item 15, revised in 14.3): the ally's [R] 1d8 Ho stays, the Guard 2d6 is gone (it measured 0.9 AP a turn as a 0 AP Active).
cards.flavor: You name the foe in your god's sight, and every blade that finds it burns.
cards.text: While your Escalation is 1 or more, at the start of each of your turns you can name one enemy within 5 squares of you. For 1 round, the first time an ally deals damage to them, they deal an extra [R] 1d8 Ho.

foundry.append: (Not automated until R-Foundry: say the enemy aloud; the ally adds the damage by hand.)

cards.name: Font of Mercy
cards._note: Pack R-classes: was a Feature every Paladin had; now one of the Escalation 1 Passives (the Lay On Hands Paladin's pick).
cards.flavor: Where you kneel, wounds remember how to close.
cards.text: While your Escalation is 1 or more, when you or an ally within 5 squares of you uses a Rally Point, they heal your Power Modifier + 2 more.

cards.name: Searing Blows
cards._note: Pack R-classes: new, the Escalation 2 wrath pick (rung budget 0.6-0.8 AP a turn: +2 on about 2.4 landing Strikes a turn is 4.8 DE, 0.83 AP on the turn table; 1d6 each was 1.4 AP: rclasses.md section 4); its Resolve damage feeds the Strained hook.
cards.flavor: Every blow you land leaves a little of the light behind.
cards.text: While your Escalation is 2 or more, your [Strike] Actions that deal damage deal an extra [R] 2 Ho.

foundry.append: (Not automated until R-Foundry: add [R] 2 Ho by hand.)

cards.name: Mending Light
cards._note: Pack R-classes: the Escalation 2 mercy pick; the amount steps by Stage (decision sheet item 18): 5 / 6 / 9 with a Power Modifier of 2 / 2 / 3 (pack MOD, 2026-11-09: the Power Modifier is now 2 / 3 / 4 for a faith-first Paladin, 1 less sword-first) (rclasses.md section 4: 4 a turn measured 0.5-0.6 AP, under the rung's 0.6-0.8).
cards.flavor: Light gathers where you stand, and the hurt are drawn to it.
cards.text: While your Escalation is 2 or more, at the start of each of your turns, you or one ally within 5 squares of you heals twice your Power Modifier + your Stage.

foundry.append: (Not automated: heal the creature you choose by hand.)

cards.name: Reckoning
cards._note: Pack R-classes, part 3 (Lucas, 2026-11-04): against Strained only (the Paladin is the class that deals Resolve damage: Strained is its hook, Bloodied the Archer's), 1d10: about 5.5 DE on the turn it fires.
cards.flavor: The weak point is where the light goes in.
cards.text: While your Escalation is 3 or more, the first [Strike] Action you make each round that deals damage to a Strained creature deals an extra [R] 1d10 Ho.

foundry.append: (Not automated until R-Foundry: add [R] 1d10 Ho by hand, once a round, against a Strained target.)

ruler.passive: escalation 3: extra 1d10 mind first-hit strike strained

cards.name: Hallowed Stance
cards._note: Pack R-classes: the Escalation 3 mercy pick; it no longer needs you to have stayed in your square (the rung 2 version measured 0.8 DE a turn), reduces every instance and twice the Power Modifier (rclasses.md section 4: late-fight reductions find little damage left to reduce).
cards.flavor: Where you stand, the light holds; so do those beside you.
cards.text: While your Escalation is 3 or more, you and your adjacent allies take less damage from each instance, reduced by twice your Power Modifier.

cards.name: Final Verdict
cards._note: Pack R-classes, part 3 (Lucas, 2026-11-04): the wrath Apex with the vocabulary: Pushed 1 on every hit (a Push's value is a maximum: 0 or 1, the Paladin's choice; the ruler found a forced Push on every hit costs a melee Paladin its next turn), Prone for a Bloodied target, Bleed [R] 1d6 Ho for a Strained one (Chapter 8); Self: you decide whether the Emanation affects you (Areas).
cards.flavor: You name every sin within reach, and the light answers all at once.

versions.effects: You roll once and compare the result to each target's AD. Each target you hit is Pushed 1 and sheds Bright light in a 1 Emanation for 1 round. A Bloodied target is Prone instead; a Strained target also gains Bleed [R] 1d6 Ho (Mi/Ap).

foundry.automationNote: the Push, Prone and Bleed by hand (the light is the template).

cards.name: Hallowed Dawn
cards._note: Pack R-classes, part 3 (Lucas, 2026-11-04): the mercy Apex: the dawn pushes the dark back (Pushed 2 away from you) and Enfeebles it; Self: you are the Emanation's target. Cards 3 (Lucas, 2026-11-05): the light lasts 1 round (was until the end of your next turn); the Allies / Enemies Apply buttons run the chain (foundry.after). v0.0.251 (Lucas's test): the Emanation is shown before the card (you included by default: areaCfg.center), Enfeebled 1 lasts the round.
cards.flavor: Dawn breaks where you stand, and it chooses sides.

versions.effects: You and each ally in the Area heal 3d6 + your Power Modifier (4d6 at Stage 2, 6d6 at Stage 3) and end one effect on them that is EoT or has 1 round left. Each enemy in the Area is Pushed 2 away from you, is Enfeebled 1 and sheds Bright light in a 1 Emanation for 1 round.

foundry.automationNote: the Apply buttons do it all: the heal (rolled once, each ally chooses the split) and the effect each ally ends; the Pushes one by one, Enfeebled 1 and the light on the enemies.
